mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_participant')
INSERT INTO utb_participant ( tbl_seq, participant_seq, user_info_seq, office_seq, participant_code, main_yn, share_ratio, note, create_user, create_at, update_user, update_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{tblSeq}, #{participantSeq}, #{userInfoSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{participantCode}, #{mainYn}, #{shareRatio}, #{note}, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createUser}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT tp.participant_seq, tp.tbl_seq, tp.user_info_seq, tp.office_seq, tp.participant_code, tp.main_yn, tp.share_ratio, tui.user_name_ko FROM utb_participant tp INNER JOIN utb_user_info tui ON tp.user_info_seq = tui.user_info_seq WHERE tp.tbl_seq = #{tblSeq} AND tp.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND tp.participant_code = #{participantCode} AND tp.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY tp.main_yn DESC, tp.share_ratio DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_participant SET del_yn = 'Y', update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE participant_seq = #{participantSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'

UPDATE utb_participant SET participant_code = #{participantCode}, note = #{note}, main_yn = #{mainYn}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE participant_seq = #{participantSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
